claims.claim: Two reviewer signatures from separate declared organizations are required for each accepted registry patch or dispute resolution.
claims.falsifier: Accept a patch with one reviewer, two identities in one organization, or an invalid signature
claims.limitation: Organizations and keys are laboratory configuration

claims.claim: An authenticated source challenge changes affected-path confirmation into review while independent unaffected paths may still confirm.
claims.falsifier: An affected bound witness confirms while the challenge remains active
claims.limitation: Only declared dependencies are checked; challenged evidence may itself be false

claims.claim: A revisioned registry refuses obsolete witness bindings or a missing/mismatched externally supplied checkpoint.
claims.falsifier: An old registry-bound witness confirms under a newer head, or confirmation occurs without any trusted checkpoint
claims.limitation: The external checkpoint is a trusted input, not actually hosted by an independent authority

claims.claim: The local in-process event log detects tested tampering, replay and concurrent exact-operation reuse.
claims.falsifier: Two simultaneous operations with the same parent/sequence both commit or logged mutations pass replay
claims.limitation: No durable cross-process, host compromise, crash recovery or production claim

claims.claim: On 20 locally authored scripted scenarios C006 governed rules and a matched conventional baseline made identical decisions.
claims.falsifier: Any differing case on the preserved inputs
claims.limitation: Equal controls share trust verification and test authors; no superiority or independent replication

claims.claim: Two authenticated, separately declared sources can confirm an experimentally false assertion.
claims.falsifier: The false-world negative-control decision stops being CONFIRMED with unchanged inputs
claims.limitation: Fake world label is fixture-defined; doesn't measure field truth

claims.claim: Governance rechecks can change a verdict after a signed challenge, but a cached admission result remains available for misuse.
claims.falsifier: An admitted status cannot persist without revalidation in a real integrated dispatch
claims.limitation: No actual provider/Action Guard integration is deployed or tested
